scripts.text: I'm Bulberry Westhood, keeping the tradition of quality hoods alive.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: If you have anything that you think is of high enough quality, come find me with ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: I can improve its high quality with my own hands.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: So you have a Loki's Scarf 1042 Special Edition. You really have an eye for quality. Can I start working on it right away?
I don't get it.
Yes, please.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: Like I said, I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: This Loki's Scarf you have is awesome. It's a limited edition product with Loki's crest on it!

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text:
My specialty is bringing out the hidden power at the small cost of... 
5 Mora Coins.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: Come back if you change your mind.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text:
I'm telling you just in case - 
If I work on a Loki's Scarf that's been upgraded before, it loses its original power.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: And worse, it can lose all its power becoming an ordinary scarf.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: Of course, the Loki's Scarf is a quality item, so you won't lose the scarf itself in the process.
Maybe later, sir...
I'd like to own a quality item!

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text:
Ha...!
You say 'later' when you can have the best quality item right away? Well, have it your own way.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: It looks like you don't everything you need.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: You must have 5 Mora Coins and a Loki's Scarf with you before you can have the best quality item.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text:
Aaarrgghh, this is impossible!
My! My Loki's Scarf!....

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: Oh, I apologize for my disgraceful behavior. I was too upset.

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: Fortunately, it's still in its original state before I started working on it. It's not torn or stretched. It's a quality item after all. Oh ho ho~

scripts.speaker: Bulberry Westhood
scripts.text: Wow~ mission complete!
